description.value: Fox Mountain Brewing Co. is Williams Lake's hometown craft brewery, pouring a rotating lineup of house-brewed beers — from a Hillbilly Blonde to a hazy IPA named Pumptrack — alongside a full kitchen menu in a taproom with patio views of Williams Lake. The brewery operates with a no-reservations walk-in policy and welcomes dogs on the patio, making it an approachable stop for travellers passing through the Cariboo. Growler fills and 4-pack takeout are available for cyclists who want to carry their haul down the road.
